cli.usage:
urftp — UltraRushFTP on the command line (site manager sites or URLs)

Usage:
  urftp sites                              list the sites of the site manager
  urftp ls   <target>                      list a remote folder
  urftp get  <target> [local folder]       download a file or a folder
  urftp put  <file|folder> <target>        upload into the remote folder
  urftp fxp  <source> <destination>        site-to-site transfer (FXP)
  urftp raw  <site> <command>...           raw commands (FTP), replies printed

Target: "SiteName:/path" (site manager, case-insensitive name)
        or URL "ftp://user:pass@host:port/path" (ftps://, ftpsi://, sftp://).

Options:
  -v, --verbose          protocol log (password masked)
  -n, --transfers <n>    simultaneous transfers per site (default: site setting)
  --exists <action>      existing file: overwrite, resume, skip, rename
  --insecure             accept any TLS certificate (FTPS)
  --fingerprint <fp>     expected SHA-256 fingerprint (FTPS certificate or SFTP host key)
  --data <folder>        settings folder (like -f of the interface)
  --lang <en|fr>         language of the messages (default: Windows language)
  -h, --help             this help
